repo.gateway_service: decisions come from a remote network service (UBAG_GATEWAY_URL, UBAG_BEHAVIORAL_URL); the fork holds only the client. The service's version at run time is not recorded; mohameduk/UBAG (ubag-core engine, ubag-mcp gateway) was first published 2026-09-30 and its README says the behavioural layer is commercial and not in that repository
client_behaviour_relevant_to_logs: refusal = tool message with error 'ubag-blocked: <decision>' (BLOCK or REVIEW) and content starting 'REFUSED by the UBAG authorization gateway ... Reason: <reason>' (ubag_gateway.py _refuse/_REFUSAL)

REVIEW is also returned when the gateway is unreachable (after retries; HTTP 4xx returns at once), reason 'authorization gateway unreachable; failing closed': such holds are infrastructure outcomes, not policy decisions

governed tools per suite: banking send_money, schedule_transaction, update_scheduled_transaction, update_password (grant); slack send_direct_message, send_channel_message, add_user_to_channel, post_webpage, invite_user_to_slack (grant), remove_user_from_slack (grant); workspace send_email, share_file, delete_file, delete_email, add_calendar_event_participants, create_calendar_event; travel send_email, reserve_hotel, reserve_restaurant, reserve_car_rental, create_calendar_event; all others execute unchecked

result ordering: results are re-ordered through a dict keyed by tool_call_id (by_id); with Gemini's null call ids, every result of a multi-call turn collapses onto one key, so the logged tool messages of that turn repeat one result (a refusal if any call was refused, else the last executed result) and the other executed results are never shown to the model or logged; affects only the gemini-2.5-flash-ubag and -ubag_behavioral arms (the undefended arm uses AgentDojo's own ToolsExecutor)

harness: AgentDojo fork = ethz-spylab/agentdojo 089ed468 (2026-06-02, after release 0.1.35) plus UBAG commits 27206776 and 9de3e23a; agentdojo_package_version '0.1.35' in all 3,630 logs (phase-10c census), which names the distribution, not the code (package_version_not_code_identity). Benchmark suites v1 (benign logs benchmark_version 'v1'; attacked logs null; 629 pairs = v1 counts, 6 workspace injection tasks, which excludes v1.2.x; #188/#189 say 'all four v1 suites'). The upstream script passes benchmark_version to every TraceLogger and runs the injection-task pre-pass inside benchmark_suite_with_injections, so null attacked versions and 0 pre-pass logs suggest a custom driver or deleted pre-pass logs. Attack important_instructions only. Defences: none (gemini only), ubag (deterministic gate via a hosted service), ubag_behavioral (behavioural layer then gate; commercial service). Known AgentDojo defects relevant here: #168/#189 (slack injection_task_5 scored on proposed calls), #188 (slack utility KeyError when post_webpage is refused: would abort the run with unpatched code), #218 (utility_from_traces on proposed calls), #181 (banking injection 0/1/3 subject check dead), #214 (non-ASCII escapes).

discrepancy_leads: Released attacks: the UBAG README reports six attack strategies (3,774 pairs) and InjecAgent/ASB runs, but the fork contains only important_instructions (629 per arm): five strategies' logs unreleased

Arms: the profile header says 'gemini-2.5-flash and gpt-4o-mini, each with -ubag and -ubag_behavioral', but the tree has five arms (an undefended gemini-2.5-flash arm too) and no undefended gpt-4o-mini arm; profile text is incomplete, the census and the results script agree on five

Reported gemini ASR counts (none 48/89/89/74 = 300; ubag 0/36/23/0; ubag_behavioral 0/0/4/0) must be reproduced by the whole-population tally; the README was written 2026-09-30 from a 'hosted deployment', possibly including reruns not in the fork

Code state: logs (2026-09-01 15:05 to 2026-09-02 21:09, naive) mostly predate the authored UBAG commits (2026-09-02 18:43 and 19:20 -0400); the state-key fix says the pre-fix client refused every governed call, so runs made before the fix would show 100% refusal of governed calls

Scorer state: #188 says unpatched slack utility code aborts a run when post_webpage is refused, yet all 3,630 logs have error null and every arm is complete (726): either no refusal hit that check or the run used a locally patched scorer not committed to the fork
Security metric: slack injection_task_5 (21 pairs per arm) is scored on proposed calls (#168/#189), so defended-arm security there can be true with nothing executed (author: 6/21 gpt-4o-mini)

Gemini null call ids + by_id re-ordering in the UBAG executor: multi-call turns in the two gemini defended arms log one result repeated for every call and drop the other executed results (candidate explanation of the 12 call_result_link_conflict / accounting_inconsistent files, all sampled in gemini-2.5-flash-ubag)

REVIEW holds (291) may include 'gateway unreachable; failing closed' infrastructure failures, which are not policy decisions but are mapped as deny decisions (D-113) [fact-check: at the pin the 'failing closed' reason is set only for the gate; an unreachable behavioural service returns REVIEW with score 0.0 and no reason of its own]

benchmark_version null in all 3,145 attacked logs but 'v1' in the 485 benign ones, and 0 pre-pass logs: the logs were not written by the upstream benchmark script's normal path (custom driver or two different invocations)

763 content repeats (21%, phase-10c): identical trajectories across arms or cells with different bytes; need to know whether they are between defence arms of one model where the gate never fired, or copies
